limitations: Resource limits are polled budgets, not hard filesystem or memory quotas.
Process-group RSS can count shared pages more than once and excludes page cache.
Reported peak RSS is the highest sample and may miss peaks between polls.
No container/cgroup memory limit is inferred by this process monitor.
Descendants that deliberately leave the process group are outside its containment.

case.derivation: RV64 bounded variant of the named SimX catalog case. The matrix pins clusters, cores, warps, native TFR tensor and STD scalar arithmetic, format enable and 64x64x64 dimensions; the rtlsim twin is explicit additional native coverage.

reference.comparison: CPU double accumulation of converted input products; abs((actual-reference)/reference) < 0.01, with exact zero pairs accepted.
